card.name: Radiation dose units like mSv and mGy
card.fires_on: Partway through radiation dose units such as mSv, mGy and microSv/MBq, on the prefix piece (m, micro, G) before Sv or Gy. Also seen on a few linking words in nuclear-medicine dosing text.

modes.label: Dose unit prefix
modes.description: The m, micro or G piece that starts a unit like mSv, mGy or microGy/MBq in radiation dosimetry tables.
modes.example: Effective dose per unit activity (<< micro>> Sv/MBq) 5.

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Occasional small words in oncology or radiopharmaceutical dosing sentences, such as with or using.
modes.example: Measure patient dose<< using>> a dose calibrator immediately before administration.

card.writes: It seems to push toward the rest of the dose unit and away from intensity-related words.
card.plain: It fires on the first part of radiation dose units like mSv or microGy/MBq in dosimetry tables.
